source.snippet: I'm trying to understand if I have a conditional access policy that only enforces MFA when a user authenticates remotely, will a user logging on the company network be forced to register a passkey after the Feb. 1st deadline if they haven't registered a passkey before the deadline and still have SMS/voice MFA as their only MFA authentication method?

problem_statement: SMB IT admins face a hard Microsoft deadline (Feb 1) to migrate all users off SMS/voice MFA to passkeys or authenticator apps, but lack clear guidance on edge cases — conditional access policies, on-prem users, legacy devices — creating compliance risk and urgent need for migration tooling or advisory.
target_segment: IT administrators at SMBs and mid-market companies running Microsoft 365 who must migrate MFA methods before the February 2027 retirement deadline.
notes: Hard regulatory/vendor deadline creates non-optional spend. IT admins at SMBs typically lack in-house identity expertise and will pay for a checklist tool, migration audit service, or managed runbook. The February 1 deadline is a real forcing function. Buyer: IT admin or MSP with a Microsoft 365 contract (already paying Microsoft). Willingness-to-pay evidence: compliance risk + time pressure.
